decisions.reason: Featured on the home page, the cloud transactional email service is a strategic growth offering that likely meets aspirations in a growing market, so management has no trigger for problemistic search.
The capture and recognition service has a dedicated page, which signals deliberate investment, and it complements the firm's document-processing core, so slack allows it time to prove itself.
Email-to-fax conversion fits the firm's established messaging business and costs little to maintain, so there is little reason to drop it despite fax's long-term decline.

This minor fax feature is only mentioned and sits in a shrinking segment, which makes it the likeliest candidate for consolidation, but its low cost means a shortfall is unlikely to force removal within a year.
Sandbox threat protection follows rising security demand and strengthens the firm's email security portfolio, so it likely meets aspirations relative to comparable providers.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a standard component of the email security bundle and is cheap to sustain, though it could later be merged into broader offerings.
